description: This file defines the 'PocketAccountMappingRepository' interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories for database operations related to 'PocketAccountMapping' entities. It contains methods for querying account mappings by ID and pocket ID.

classes.name: PocketAccountMappingRepository
classes.description: Spring Data repository interface for PocketAccountMapping entity, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByIdAndPocketId
methods.description: Retrieves a PocketAccountMapping entity based on its ID and associated pocket ID.

methods.name: findByPocketId
methods.description: Retrieves all PocketAccountMapping entities associated with a specific pocket ID.
